comments.body: It's possible learn bow techs using this bow? No matter how much fights i do usint it, i can't learn the first of the bow techs.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Any bow-type weapon can be used to acquire bow techs. It may take one battle, or it may take 2 hours' worth of them -- think of techs as a 'random drop', if it helps.

But as long as you meet the requirements (and all Lv1 techs just require the weapon type equipped) then they will be acquired in time. If you continue to experience problems in acquiring the desired tech(s), you can always change to another bow weapon (though I don't feel it is needed).

And if you *really* believe there is a bug however, you can always submit a support ticket for PapayaPlay concerning it. Be sure to thoroughly test it on your end before doing so, however. Cheers and great online voyaging to you.
